title: did_webvh controller: witnesses
description: mls_didwebvh::controller writes no witness parameter and no did-witness.json. Verification supports witnesses (tested with generated and DIF-suite logs). Adding: a witness parameter in create/append, collecting witness proofs (eddsa-jcs-2022 over {versionId}), and keeping a per-device witness file for the device's head (feedback item 10: pruning).
